summary: Evaluate parallel current density from explicit pressure/logarithmic gradients and fit coefficients. The two named fields are returned in one scirel._result.Result mapping.

capability: Parallel current density from explicit pressure and logarithmic gradients with Sauter or Redl fit coefficients.
operation: Evaluate the analytic parallel bootstrap current
explicit face profiles, gradients and fit coefficients -> parallel current density
discovery.model: Bounded analytic empirical tokamak fit (Sauter PoP 1999 Eq. 12 or Redl PoP 2021 Eq. 5); not a first-principles neoclassical solve.
discovery.geometry: Caller-supplied axisymmetric tokamak face data on a radius rho_face, with the poloidal-flux derivative given either as total flux (Wb) or per radian (Wb/rad); no device geometry is built in.
discovery.boundary: Only a face at rho_face == 0 is the magnetic axis and gets exactly zero current; all gradients are explicit; coefficients are evaluated for the supplied faces only.

identity.relation: Sauter PoP1999 Eq12 / Redl PoP2021 Eq5
identity.definition: j_face=-F*multiplier/(B0*dpsi_per_radian_drho) * [L31*pe*dlnne+L31*pi*dlnni+(L31+L32)*pe*dlnTe+(L31+alpha*L34)*pi*dlnTi], with dpsi_per_radian_drho = dpsi_drho/(2*pi) when the total-flux form is given. Exactly one flux-derivative convention is accepted; both or neither raise ValueError. A face with rho_face == 0 is the axis and is set exactly to zero; no other face is zeroed. Cells use adjacent arithmetic face midpoints with the overflow-safe finite midpoint implementation. The two named arrays are returned together in one scirel._result.Result mapping; mapping lookup and attribute access expose the same fields.
identity.coordinates: rho_face normalized radius (nonnegative, strictly increasing); poloidal-flux derivative as total flux dpsi_drho_face [Wb] or per radian dpsi_per_radian_drho_face [Wb/rad]
identity.boundary: Only a face with rho_face == 0 is the magnetic axis and gets exactly zero current; all gradients are explicit
assumptions: Finite converted-binary64 input quantities; caller supplies consistent units and normalization

inputs.name: bootstrap_multiplier
inputs.description: Dimensionless multiplicative scale; signed algebra preserved
inputs.constraints: Finite real scalar; physical source configuration uses nonnegative multiplier

inputs.name: rho_face
inputs.description: Radial coordinate of the faces. A face at rho_face == 0 is the magnetic axis and gets zero current; no other face is treated as the axis.
inputs.constraints: Finite, nonnegative and strictly increasing; sets the face shape of every other array

inputs.name: F_face
inputs.description: Toroidal flux function R*B_toroidal on faces

inputs.name: B0
inputs.description: Reference toroidal magnetic field with a signed convention

inputs.name: dpsi_drho_face
inputs.description: Derivative of the TOTAL poloidal flux (2*pi times the per-radian psi = R*A_phi) with respect to rho_face. Give this or dpsi_per_radian_drho_face, not both.
inputs.constraints: Exactly one of dpsi_drho_face or dpsi_per_radian_drho_face; finite matching faces, nonzero wherever rho_face > 0

inputs.name: dpsi_per_radian_drho_face
inputs.description: Derivative of the poloidal flux per radian psi = R*A_phi (the G-EQDSK and scirel.io.read_geqdsk convention) with respect to rho_face. Give this or dpsi_drho_face, not both.
inputs.constraints: Exactly one of dpsi_drho_face or dpsi_per_radian_drho_face; finite matching faces, nonzero wherever rho_face > 0

inputs.name: L34
inputs.description: Ion-temperature coefficient; Redl must use L31

outputs.name: j_parallel_bootstrap_face
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: parallel current density <j.B>/B0 on faces; zero at a face with rho_face == 0
outputs.constraints: Finite; equal explicit one-dimensional face shape; no broadcasting

outputs.name: j_parallel_bootstrap
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: arithmetic adjacent-face cell current density
outputs.constraints: Finite; equal explicit one-dimensional face shape; no broadcasting

preconditions: Declared shapes, domains and matching scientific conventions; no implicit broadcasting
supported: Evaluate parallel current density from explicit pressure/logarithmic gradients and fit coefficients
excluded: Empirical coefficients are not experimentally calibrated here. Caller must supply model-consistent collisionalities and trapped fraction; no geometry reconstruction, edge pedestal or full-transport physics qualification.
Large finite charge/collisionality combinations may have nonrepresentable intermediate or final arithmetic and fail explicitly. Float64 conversion cannot recover prior lost precision.

Physical interpretation assumes axisymmetric tokamak geometry, nonnegative scalar thermal pressures, positive density/temperature before forming their logarithms, and compatible poloidal-flux/field sign conventions. Signed inputs retain algebra only.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for malformed, nonfinite, masked, mismatched or out-of-domain face inputs; no partial result.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: FloatingPointError for nonfinite coefficient/current arithmetic; no fallback is returned.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; these are direct analytic fit and arithmetic mappings.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No scirel._result.Result mapping is returned on failure.

python.signature: calculate_bootstrap_current(*, bootstrap_multiplier=1.0, rho_face, F_face, B0, dpsi_drho_face=None, dpsi_per_radian_drho_face=None, p_e_face, p_i_face, dlnne_drho_face, dlnni_drho_face, dlnte_drho_face, dlnti_drho_face, L31, L32, L34, alpha)

example.description: Check the axis zero and that the total-flux and per-radian forms agree.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel._result import Result
from scirel.neoclassical import calculate_bootstrap_current
one=np.ones(3); zero=np.zeros(3)
kw=dict(rho_face=[0.,.5,1.],F_face=one,B0=2.,p_e_face=one,p_i_face=one,dlnne_drho_face=one,dlnni_drho_face=zero,dlnte_drho_face=zero,dlnti_drho_face=zero,L31=one,L32=zero,L34=one,alpha=one)
x=calculate_bootstrap_current(dpsi_drho_face=one,**kw)
assert isinstance(x, Result)
assert list(x) == ['j_parallel_bootstrap_face', 'j_parallel_bootstrap']
assert x.j_parallel_bootstrap_face is x['j_parallel_bootstrap_face']
np.testing.assert_allclose(x['j_parallel_bootstrap_face'],[0,-np.pi,-np.pi])
y=calculate_bootstrap_current(dpsi_per_radian_drho_face=one/(2*np.pi),**kw)
np.testing.assert_allclose(y['j_parallel_bootstrap_face'],x['j_parallel_bootstrap_face'])
example.expected: The returned object is a scirel._result.Result mapping with fields readable by key and attribute. Face current is [0,-pi,-pi] in both conventions.

scope: Independent Decimal fit checks, source-bound coefficient/caller parity and finite arithmetic regressions
The named-result migration preserves existing key order, values, shape and dtype while exposing the same fields by attribute.

Total-flux and per-radian flux derivatives agree; giving both or neither, a non-increasing or negative rho_face, or a zero flux derivative off the axis raise ValueError; an off-axis first face is not zeroed.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Mathematical fit arithmetic and explicit assembly only; no empirical full-physics qualification.

Large finite charge/collisionality combinations may have nonrepresentable intermediate or final arithmetic and fail explicitly. Float64 conversion cannot recover prior lost precision.
